articles.summary: Atmos Energy Corporation (NYSE: ATO) will host a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 10 a.m. Eastern to review the company’s Fiscal 2026 financial results, establish guidance for Fiscal 2027, and refresh the company’s five-year plan through Fiscal 2031. Atmos Energy will release these results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, following the market close. To listen to the conference call, please dial either the toll-free or international number provided below. You may also listen to the call on the Atmos Energy website at www.atmosenergy.com . The Internet broadcast will be archived for 30 days. Conference Call Details November 5, 2026 10 a.m. Eastern / 9 a.m. Central U.S. Toll-free: +1 833-461-5787 International: +1 585-542-9983 Meeting ID: 232 888 973 Internet webcast: www.atmosenergy.com Atmos Energy Corporation, a natural gas-only distributor, is an SP 500 company headquartered in Dallas. articles.title: Atmos Energy Corporation to Host Fiscal 2026 Year End Earnings Conference Call on November 5, 2026
